news.title: Zantat Holdings Reallocates RM1 Million IPO Proceeds To Working Capital, Extends Utilisation Period

recent_en: ZANTAT had several director dealing announcements in November 2026, including share dealings and intention to deal during closed period by Executive Vice Chairman Chan Bin Iuan. In September 2026, the company reallocated RM1 million of IPO proceeds to working capital and extended the utilisation period. The latest quarterly report (for the period ended 30 September 2026) was released.
notable_en: Executive Vice Chairman Chan Bin Iuan acquired 59,100 ordinary shares at RM0.135 per share during the closed period.
The company reallocated RM1 million of IPO proceeds to working capital and extended the utilisation period.
risks_en: Executive Vice Chairman Chan Bin Iuan traded shares during the closed period and announced an intention to deal.
